settings.chatTemplate: Application template: Doppler formatChatMessages type qwen, thinking off (non-thinking prefill), no system message
settings.decoding: greedy (catalog temperature 0, topK 1, topP 1, repetitionPenalty 1, presencePenalty 0)

rules.itemPass: An item passes for an arm when every check on every turn passes for that arm. Items with judgment 'human' have no mechanical checks; they are graded against their rubric and reported separately.
rules.twoTurn: Turn 2 is sent with the history [turn-1 user, the same arm's own turn-1 answer verbatim, turn-2 user], as the application builds it from completed messages.
rules.promptLimit: Every turn-1 prompt is at most 250 tokens by construction. If an arm's own turn-1 answer makes its turn-2 prompt exceed 250 tokens, turn 2 is still generated and checked for information, but the item is recorded as promptLimitExceeded and does not pass for that arm, because the installed route could not serve that prompt.
rules.emptyAnswer: An answer that is empty after trimming is a failed response, as the application rejects it. If turn 1 of a two-turn item is empty, turn 2 is not run and the item does not pass.
rules.maxTokens: An answer stopped at maxTokens is checked as delivered (truncated).
rules.textNormalization: Text checks see the delivered answer with Markdown emphasis markers (** and __) and backticks removed, curly quotes and apostrophes straightened, non-breaking spaces made plain and runs of spaces and tabs collapsed. Matching is case-insensitive unless caseSensitive is true.

checkTypes.contains: The answer contains at least one ('any') or every ('all') listed string.
checkTypes.excludes: The answer contains none of the listed strings.
checkTypes.regex: Python re.search of the pattern finds a match.
checkTypes.notRegex: Python re.search of the pattern finds no match.
checkTypes.number: Some number written in the answer equals value within tolerance. Thousands separators and currency symbols are ignored; a minus sign counts only when it is not joined to a preceding letter or digit.
checkTypes.onlyAnswer: After removing one surrounding code fence, backticks, emphasis markers, surrounding quotes and whitespace, and one trailing period or exclamation mark, the whole answer matches the pattern.
checkTypes.finalArray: The last bracketed list of numbers in the answer, skipping any list equal to an 'ignore' entry (echoes of the input), equals 'equals'.
checkTypes.bullets: Lines starting with -, *, + or a bullet character and a space are bullets. Their number equals 'count'. With 'only', every non-empty line is a bullet.
checkTypes.numberedList: Lines starting with a number followed by '.' or ')' are items. Their number equals 'count'. With 'only', every non-empty line is an item. With 'itemsFrom', each item's text (emphasis and trailing punctuation removed) is one of the listed names, case-insensitive; with 'distinct', no name repeats.
checkTypes.lines: After removing one surrounding code fence, the number of non-empty lines equals 'count'.
checkTypes.words: Whitespace-separated tokens containing a letter or digit; their number is within 'min' and 'max'. With 'skipLeadIn', a first line ending in a colon (such as 'Here is a shorter version:') is not counted.
checkTypes.sentences: Sentence-ending punctuation (., !, ?) followed by whitespace or the end, plus one if the last text lacks it; the count is within 'min' and 'max'. The abbreviations a.m., p.m., e.g., i.e., vs., Mr., Mrs., Ms. and Dr. do not end sentences. With 'skipLeadIn', a first line ending in a colon is not counted.
checkTypes.json: After removing one surrounding code fence, the whole answer parses as a JSON object with exactly the listed keys; string values compare case-insensitively after trimming.
